A migrator would manufacture key_expression, basis and provenance values that v1 never asked its author for -- a value with no measurement behind it, carrying the authority of a schema-conformant field. mutant.description: Seven mutations of the REAL delivered cards through the same validator that admitted them, each a failure this contract exists to catch: key_expression basis 'inferred' (v3.1's own narrowing); schema_version 1 (the legacy contract the issuer misrouted to and corrected @6a0e8e85de); a NULL key_expression claimed as measured; key_expression removed; substrate question 7 (distinguishable_from_true_negative) removed; an off-enum basis value; prose jammed back into a joinable id. Paired with the three unmutated cards as the positive control.
mutant.expected: All seven REFUSED; the three real cards VALID.
mutant.observed: 7 of 7 REFUSED; positive control 3 of 3 VALID. STATED BECAUSE IT MATTERS: the first run of this battery reported 5 of 5 refused while the base was REFUSED on all three cards -- a battery from a failing base means nothing, and the summary line asserting 'all three VALID' was hardcoded rather than derived from the result. Both were corrected: the cards were repaired to the joinable_ref contract and the verdict line is now computed from the validator's own output.

surprises: OBSERVATION / INERT (3.0.0_SA_CVO~X, cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~X): THE THREE RAILS GAVE THREE DIFFERENT KINDS OF KEY ANSWER, and D2's is the one worth the issuer's attention: key_expression is NULL with basis ABSENT because a path is a transitive closure with no stored identity, and no minting rule is declared anywhere in the rail. That is a real gap in the rail, surfaced rather than papered over with a plausible expression -- and it is exactly what a migrator would have manufactured.

Its type space is fully measured (4 of 4 tokens, computable expression) but its instance population is ZERO and the declared instance home -- ESTATE WS-E1's registry -- does not exist. A consumer cannot use the rail today except to refuse. The live consequence: every completeness or freshness question over the estate resolves against an absent contract right now, and a consumer defaulting absent-to-satisfied gets universal false compliance. Owner of the remedy is the ESTATE WS-E1 lane, not this one.

OBSERVATION / INERT (3.0.0_SA_CVO~X, cc 2.0.0_SA_COO~X): MY OWN FIRST VALIDATION RUN PRINTED A FALSE SUMMARY. It reported 'all three real cards VALID (positive control)' as a hardcoded string while the validator had just REFUSED all three, and it then reported a 5-of-5 mutant battery from that failing base. Caught by reading the rows above the summary. Recorded because it is the same defect class this project keeps finding in other carriers -- a summary line that asserts rather than derives -- and a self-report is the one place it is least likely to be audited.
